name: Ring of Steam
body:
Aura moderate transmutation; CL 9th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears to be a ring of water walking and functions as such. If the wearer stays within the same 5 foot water square for more than 1 round, however, the water beneath his feet erupts into a rolling boil, causing 1d4 points of damage per round.

The ring may only be removed by casting remove curse on the wearer destroying the ring, turning it to water.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of water walking

Identification DC 34
False Identification DC 24
